pages.text: $(bold)Artillery Scope$()$(br2)Right-click while holding a cannon to enter scope mode for precision aiming.$(br2)$(bold)Features:$()$(br)• Magnified view for long-range targeting$(br)• Crosshair for precise aim$(br)• Ballistic prediction line$(br)• Range estimation

$(bold)Controls:$()$(br)• Hold right-click: Aim$(br)• Mouse: Adjust aim$(br)• Scroll wheel: Adjust zoom level$(br)• Tap left-click: Fire one ready cannon, preferring the held cannon$(br)• Hold left-click: Fire ready cannons of the same type at salvo intervals$(br)• Release to stop firing
